title: Second order asymptotics for the number of times an estimator is more than epsilon from its target value
summary: Suppose $\{\widehatθ_n\colon n\ge1\}$ is a strongly consistent sequence of estimators for a parameter $θ$, where $\widehatθ_n$ is based on the first $n$ observations. Consider $Q_\varepsilon$, the number of times $|\widehatθ_n-θ|\ge\varepsilon$. In another paper (Hjort and Fenstad, 1992) we have shown that $\varepsilon^2 Q_\varepsilon$ has a limit distribution as $\varepsilon\rightarrow0$, depending only on $σ$, the standard deviation of the limit distribution for $\sqrt{n}(\widehatθ_n-θ)$, under natural regularity conditions.
